beats.vo: This is Groundtruth, a Chrome extension for home buyers, on a real realestate.com.au listing. It reads only the address. Up top: what it should really sell for, about eight hundred and thirty-two thousand, against a Microburbs value of seven eighty-five.
beats.caption: [[Chrome extension]] on realestate.com.au · what it should sell for vs Microburbs value
beats.action: s1 3–20: page load, panel, price check.

beats.vo: Tap Verified home and the address match receipt opens: the address it read, the G-NAF ID of the exact home, and four of four checks.
beats.caption: [[Address match]] receipt · address read · G-NAF id · 4/4 checks

beats.vo: From the Microburbs API: seven of this agency's last ten sales sold above their guide, typically by three point nine percent.
beats.caption: [[Microburbs API]]: 7 of 10 of this agency's sales sold above guide

beats.vo: A buyer can type the guide they were quoted. Nine hundred thousand differs from the guide on record, and sits fifteen percent above Microburbs' estimate.
beats.caption: Your guide ($900k) vs record ($800k) · [[15% above]] Microburbs' estimate

beats.vo: Realestate.com.au swaps listings in place. Here's Goulburn Street, about one point three million. Back to the results, pick Bourke Street, and the receipt updates to the new home.
beats.caption: In-page listing switch · the receipt [[updates]] to the new home
beats.action: s6 14–39: Goulburn St → back → 902/417-419 Bourke St.

beats.vo: Domain works too: Cooper Street, Surry Hills, an exact address match. Now, the thirty-second briefing.
beats.caption: domain.com.au · 405/82-92 Cooper St · [[exact match]]
beats.action: s7 0–11: Domain listing with the panel.

beats.vo: (Recorded 30-second briefing for 405/82-92 Cooper St, ElevenLabs voice.)
beats.caption: Real [[30-second briefing]] · captions in the panel
beats.action: s7 203–230: briefing plays, captions in the panel.

beats.vo: What listings never show: what can legally rise next door. The 3D view raises nearby lots to their planning limits. Here, two lots within a hundred metres could rise four to five more storeys.
beats.caption: What can [[legally rise next door]] — live on realestate.com.au
beats.action: s3d: real realestate.com.au panel, 902/417-419 Bourke St; slow push-in to the rendered 3D map.

beats.vo: When a listing hides the unit number, Groundtruth won't guess. It asks the buyer how many bedrooms, and narrows the building.
beats.caption: Hidden unit: no guessing · tap [[bedrooms]] to narrow
beats.action: Demo page: 417-419 Bourke St, Building state, tap 2.

beats.vo: Outside the City of Sydney pilot, like Bondi, it says so, and makes no data call.
beats.caption: Bondi: out of area · [[no data call]]
beats.action: Demo page: Bondi, Out of area.

beats.vo: On thirty held-out real listings: zero wrong homes, fifteen of twenty matched exactly, and all four out-of-area listings caught.
beats.caption: 30 held-out real listings · [[0 wrong homes]] · 15 of 20 exact · 4 of 4 out of area

still.name: accuracy-demo
still.heading: [[Address match]] on 30 held-out real listings
still.note: Labels frozen before the run · eval/FROZEN.md · eval/results.md

beats.vo: Limits. Agency data appears only while a home is listed with a tracked agency. The Microburbs value covers about thirteen percent of homes. And it's City of Sydney only, for now.
beats.caption: Limits, stated plainly

still.heading: Limits
bullets: Agency data only while listed with a [[tracked agency]]
City of Sydney's 29 suburbs only, for now

beats.vo: Groundtruth. Built on the Microburbs API: address match, planning controls, valuations. Ready to drop into any property extension.
beats.caption: Built on the [[Microburbs API]] · ready for any property extension
